items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in a related area and/or equivalent experience/training.

Leadership and direct management experience in affordable housing research, affordable housing finance, or related areas. This includes experience overseeing teams, mentoring professional colleagues, and/or directly managing staff or students.
Experience or strong interest in fundraising.

Experience in designing and implementing quantitative research, including collection and management of financial data and statistical analysis of factors associated with affordable housing production, costs, and other outcomes.

Min. 5 years of relevant experience working in affordable housing finance or real estate, such as research experience in academia, industry, non-profit, government, or a public policy or research organization.

40%  Manages the design and development of major research projects and oversees the implementation and successful completion of those efforts. This includes effective project management skills, strong independent writing and editorial skills and an ability to review the quality of writing, data collection, data analysis, and report production processes among subordinate staff and ensuring statistical integrity, adequacy and accuracy of the data.
10%  Develops proposals for new research projects with input from the leadership team, including identifying quantitative and qualitative data sources, statistical methods, and project timelines.
10%  Disseminates research findings in collaboration with the communications team to adapt research papers to reach various audiences through summaries, blog posts, and other methods.

10%  Performs supervisory functions including recruitment of research associates and graduate student researchers, and is responsible for mentoring and training students and staff as well as handling disciplinary issues when needed.
10%  Tracks and monitors relevant current events, policy analysis papers, and government activities and participates and presents research in relevant conferences, seminars, and meetings.
5%    Stewards industry and philanthropic partnerships, helps recruit and support advisory board members, faculty research affiliates, fellows, and other partners.
5%    Identifies, develops and executes strategic plan for fundraising for program activities and ensuring ongoing sustainability of affordable housing finance related projects.
5%    Participates in developing and monitoring operational and budget processes, staff FTE, finance, and human resources.
5%    Responds to requests from media, external stakeholders and regional partners for data analysis and research implications.
Research background and recognized expertise in affordable housing finance and policy research.
Demonstrated expertise in building collaborations between agencies and sectors, including, non-profit, academia, industry, and/or governmental agencies. Expertise with program building.

Exceptional organizational, project management, communication, interpersonal, and writing skills, including the ability to effectively communicate quantitative and qualitative findings to non-academic audiences.
Knowledge of federal, state, and municipal affordable housing programs.
Expert oral and written communication skills.

Knowledge and ability to incorporate issues that interact with affordable housing finance into research methods, including aligning with equity and environmental goals and increasing access to quality homes and community in ways that support racial, social, and economic inclusion.
Expert ability to work with a dynamic and diverse group of faculty, staff, and students.
Ability to manage multiple important priorities, including an ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and deadlines.
